about: A dental or health information site: no medical promise, no diagnosis, a line that the post is no medical advice.

bg.compliance_long: Информацията не замества консултация с лекар по дентална медицина.
bg.voice_notes: Спокойно, ясно и грижовно; учтиво „вие“; без плашене и без обещания; без тирета (—).
bg.register_words: запишете се сега, обадете се сега, резервирайте сега

en.compliance_long: This information does not replace a consultation with a dentist.
en.voice_notes: Calm, clear and caring; no scaring and no promises; no em-dashes (—).
en.register_words: book now, call now, sign up now

writing_rules: Never promise a medical result: no "painless", "guaranteed", "permanent", "100%" unless the source says it word for word about a fact, not a promise.
No diagnosis and no advice for a person's own case: send them to a dentist.
Prices, durations and success rates only as the source states them.
art_rules: NO blood, open wounds, needles, drills in a mouth or real patients; NO before-and-after pictures. Clean, calm and friendly: teeth, toothbrushes, a dental chair, a calendar.
review_rules: Any blood, wound, needle, real patient, before-and-after picture or promise of a medical result is a failure.
